Overviewنبذة
Social Media and Content Manager مدير المحتوى ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي
Part-time · Hybrid · Riyadh · Reports to the founder

The role keeps content moving for Moona's clients, and it runs Moona's own presence. It sits between production and account management. You plan and edit content, run live accounts across four platforms, and keep each client on schedule and on brand. Part of the work is client-facing.

الوصف الوظيفي03
Responsibilitiesالمهام
01
Content and production
  • Coordinate video shoots and editing for clients.
  • Produce content for each platform and format it for each one.
  • Hold quality and tone to each client's identity.
02
Client accounts
  • Run client accounts on Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. LinkedIn is handled separately.
  • Own scheduling and delivery, so content ships on time across every account.
  • Handle day-to-day client communication where it is needed.
03
Moona's own marketing
  • Plan and run Moona's own social accounts.
  • Build the content calendar and campaigns for Moona.
  • Keep Moona's presence in line with the brand.

الوصف الوظيفي04
What the role needsالمتطلبات
  • Hands-on video editing and content production. You can take a shoot and turn it into finished posts.
  • Fluency across Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok, including what each format needs.
  • Organized and reliable with scheduling, so nothing slips across several accounts at once.
  • Strong written Arabic and English.
  • A feel for brand consistency and a calm, considered style.
  • Comfortable speaking with clients directly.
Working arrangementترتيبات العمل
  • Part-time and hybrid, based in Riyadh.
  • On-site four hours a day, a couple of days each week. We set the days together.
  • The rest of the work is remote.
  • Reports to the founder.
Next
Compensation and start date are agreed in the contract, once the working days are set.
